636d4a4e7f3e2ab72820216f99e1f626.speaker: Narration
636d4a4e7f3e2ab72820216f99e1f626.text: Vishvamitra led the princes to Siddhashrama, where the sages would keep a sacred fire for six nights.

c28592167396a344060cb9893e49f2d8.speaker: Vishvamitra
c28592167396a344060cb9893e49f2d8.text: This is Siddhashrama. Vishnu himself once sat here in tapas, as Vamana. Sages have kept fire here ever since.

4b85ecc1d55bb8ebeaf2e5eb55055af1.speaker: Vishvamitra
4b85ecc1d55bb8ebeaf2e5eb55055af1.text: Here the yagna begins. For six nights the sages will not speak, and this fire must not fail.

1bccd3b4967c25a0349521821cb5f273.speaker: Vishvamitra
1bccd3b4967c25a0349521821cb5f273.text: Maricha and Subahu will come, as they always come, with rakshasas behind them. Guard the fire, princes of Raghu.

64f9c5db93cd7f77ba13a2c19f74946b.speaker: Lakshmana
64f9c5db93cd7f77ba13a2c19f74946b.text: Let them come, Guru-dev. We will be waiting.

91babb11578005b89ef2107091fd14aa.speaker: Rama
91babb11578005b89ef2107091fd14aa.text: No one will put out this fire while I stand.

dd7aef7f403dfce52cae0865ce6780ce.speaker: Narration
dd7aef7f403dfce52cae0865ce6780ce.text: And at dawn on the seventh day, the yagna was complete.

4ab0b75c906343d582ba058defc230a6.speaker: Vishvamitra
4ab0b75c906343d582ba058defc230a6.text: The fire is whole. You kept your word, Rama, and you kept your mercy.

766f59929b8cd00d89b8dbb87c32c9b7.speaker: Rama
766f59929b8cd00d89b8dbb87c32c9b7.text: The sages kept six nights of silence, Guru-dev. We only kept watch.

047d95f43f3ef7d066afc0775a45e5e1.speaker: Vishvamitra
047d95f43f3ef7d066afc0775a45e5e1.text: Now come with me. In Mithila, King Janaka keeps a bow that no man has ever strung.

24cd289ee8043beeda8d8f2509195031.speaker: Lakshmana
24cd289ee8043beeda8d8f2509195031.text: A bow no one can string? Brother, I think we should see it.

d967ba7741f46dd2644b7dde576d2fa4.speaker: Narration
d967ba7741f46dd2644b7dde576d2fa4.text: They walked into lands where no bird sang: the lands of Malada and Karusha.

62ede25362a07c05048c0d7b397855ff.speaker: Lakshmana
62ede25362a07c05048c0d7b397855ff.text: Guru-dev, these fields were farmed once. Who would leave land like this?

f5433bdd0b4e62ed538275a1cd33346c.speaker: Vishvamitra
f5433bdd0b4e62ed538275a1cd33346c.text: No bird sings here. Listen to what silence costs a land.

510165d94e7b857d0e01fece449c2c1a.speaker: Vishvamitra
510165d94e7b857d0e01fece449c2c1a.text: Tataka rules this forest. Once a yakshini of great strength, she became a terror after a sage's curse. Her son Maricha follows her.

5b21351fd27d4c78433a974332be7ac4.speaker: Vishvamitra
5b21351fd27d4c78433a974332be7ac4.text: These were rich countries once. She has unmade them, village by village.

c62f2fe8058ed6ec9847cd5cad898ab0.speaker: Rama
c62f2fe8058ed6ec9847cd5cad898ab0.text: Then we will not walk through quietly.

07f44fcf5971e5d66321a1fbbccd3e3c.speaker: Lakshmana
07f44fcf5971e5d66321a1fbbccd3e3c.text: Stay close, brother. The trees themselves are watching.

2b2b094a2e1eb9c5817c47621f4133a4.speaker: Narration
2b2b094a2e1eb9c5817c47621f4133a4.text: On the sixth night, the sky itself grew dark.

4d1b81f31a60eb1dabd78922d4d2c825.speaker: Lakshmana
4d1b81f31a60eb1dabd78922d4d2c825.text: Brother... the stars are going out.

f3008e5fd871e27ee4a3ef7bd6016062.speaker: Subahu
f3008e5fd871e27ee4a3ef7bd6016062.text: Little princes with little bows! We will drown your sage's fire in blood!

06cfa4d3a72237008b1f91431c8be553.speaker: Maricha
06cfa4d3a72237008b1f91431c8be553.text: Tataka's sons have come for those who killed her.

89ce635025da15b70cb7a4c6db29d5f8.speaker: Rama
89ce635025da15b70cb7a4c6db29d5f8.text: Turn back while you still can. This fire is not yours to put out.

dadb93a8a103977943ad42470cbbe570.speaker: Narration
dadb93a8a103977943ad42470cbbe570.text: Golden Ayodhya, on the banks of the Sarayu. The princes trained beneath their guru's eye...

aa61994d6dc45ce7083732db698e29ce.speaker: Rama
aa61994d6dc45ce7083732db698e29ce.text: The bow pulls when I breathe, Guru-dev.

279ae071ed969650819c61f167ef6b98.speaker: Vasishtha
279ae071ed969650819c61f167ef6b98.text: Then do not fight your breath. Let the arrow leave between one breath and the next.

33ceb37b4abb6ffd2221a0a1b6af8c96.speaker: Vasishtha
33ceb37b4abb6ffd2221a0a1b6af8c96.text: An arrow obeys the hand. The hand must obey something higher.

726c497cf8a7db8e9dd9ba6a7f0a0337.speaker: Vasishtha
726c497cf8a7db8e9dd9ba6a7f0a0337.text: Dharma. The heart can be mistaken.

ab014a2842264d319b522351da5a46eb.speaker: Lakshmana
ab014a2842264d319b522351da5a46eb.text: Brother, leave one for me. Just one.

61a6fffdee6d3b9f42bcebb720cbd99a.speaker: Rama
61a6fffdee6d3b9f42bcebb720cbd99a.text: Watch my left, then, and I will leave you the last.

e217177bafa233251f0f9fb1417de09e.speaker: Vasishtha
e217177bafa233251f0f9fb1417de09e.text: Then let us see what you have learned. These are only shadows of my making. Face them as if they were not.

b8b31f65f63fc3dff8103e7e53af44db.speaker: Narration
b8b31f65f63fc3dff8103e7e53af44db.text: On the second night, a fog of maya rose from the forest.

e4786f7fb38b1fe6653c0edca820fb3b.speaker: Vishvamitra
e4786f7fb38b1fe6653c0edca820fb3b.text: Illusions, Rama. Of every shape you see, only one is true. Look for the one that shimmers.

6f246663c93dac9729ca32e2ee5ba007.speaker: Narration
6f246663c93dac9729ca32e2ee5ba007.text: On the third night, arrows flew from the dark between the trees.

9ba9341b743409b1590436fb4abf2c94.speaker: Lakshmana
9ba9341b743409b1590436fb4abf2c94.text: They are shooting from the trees! And more torches behind them.

9ca56b48deedf984aca72eb4da31ca76.speaker: Narration
9ca56b48deedf984aca72eb4da31ca76.text: On the fourth night, the rakshasas came for the sages themselves.

97928f65242de052330db91073774fa8.speaker: Vishvamitra
97928f65242de052330db91073774fa8.text: The sages must not move, whatever comes. Their lives are in your hands now.

64f0d70eb57c3997ebdf1f5d27335561.speaker: Narration
64f0d70eb57c3997ebdf1f5d27335561.text: On the fifth night, the whole forest seemed to march on the ashram.

e0696f5ea9ad83a319945908a014ad25.speaker: Lakshmana
e0696f5ea9ad83a319945908a014ad25.text: Brother... that one is the size of a tree.

f054d955cada8feb39098a9527116104.speaker: Rama
f054d955cada8feb39098a9527116104.text: Size is not strength, brother. Stand with me.

d728966b1fc98f810076ba29fc9396f0.speaker: Narration
d728966b1fc98f810076ba29fc9396f0.text: Then came a sage to the palace gate, and with him the first step of a long road.

30c81cd68e4805318047e853f4561b4e.speaker: Dasharatha
30c81cd68e4805318047e853f4561b4e.text: Vishvamitra! Rain has come to a dry field. Ask, great one. Whatever you ask is already given.

7a71c0834d19235bc4ccb1344719dc93.speaker: Vishvamitra
7a71c0834d19235bc4ccb1344719dc93.text: You have said it, King, and a king's word is a vow. Hear what I ask before you say it again.

879e686f3d745bba7797c1079fbba1b2.speaker: Vishvamitra
879e686f3d745bba7797c1079fbba1b2.text: Two rakshasas, Maricha and Subahu, rain blood upon my sacrifice. My vow forbids me to curse them.

013b9d6d5124c858ceefda9459e79fd8.speaker: Vishvamitra
013b9d6d5124c858ceefda9459e79fd8.text: Give me Rama, your eldest, for ten nights. He alone can end this.

8d87a376e2a5d7df4acd76635890db49.speaker: Dasharatha
8d87a376e2a5d7df4acd76635890db49.text: He is not yet sixteen. He has never seen a battle. Take my army. Take me. Not my son.

5272f2e5e5f98c0e478e65ce8e6291e6.speaker: Dasharatha
5272f2e5e5f98c0e478e65ce8e6291e6.text: I waited half my life for him. Do not ask me to give him to the night.

036addc5b8c67cd596022e442cd20751.speaker: Vishvamitra
036addc5b8c67cd596022e442cd20751.text: A king who promises and then bargains has forgotten whose son he is.

27b0db5ead48de06d6860527b7596b3f.speaker: Vishvamitra
27b0db5ead48de06d6860527b7596b3f.text: So be it. I will go as I came. Live happily among your kinsmen, King of the Raghus.

6cf5dfbfa08f8dea195a0607d5b0addb.speaker: Narration
6cf5dfbfa08f8dea195a0607d5b0addb.text: The earth trembled at the sage's anger, and even the gods grew still.

bab707020169edbd4e2ea3740ab14b60.speaker: Vasishtha
bab707020169edbd4e2ea3740ab14b60.text: My king. You were born in the line of Ikshvaku. Truth is your inheritance. Do not cast it away.

1f7204d6e9a16d1fb2082e133a33dd17.speaker: Vasishtha
1f7204d6e9a16d1fb2082e133a33dd17.text: This sage is master of every astra known to gods or men. Rama is safer at his side than behind any wall of ours.

e156a7321be42572070240bcb6ff98e8.speaker: Vasishtha
e156a7321be42572070240bcb6ff98e8.text: He does not ask for Rama because he needs a guard. He asks because he means to give him something.

1d06dc37c37913085e1d1994da65eb9f.speaker: Rama
1d06dc37c37913085e1d1994da65eb9f.text: Father, I will return. Bless the bow, not only the boy.

5a702c5ef1aa0fb27b1df8e0e4ea0570.speaker: Lakshmana
5a702c5ef1aa0fb27b1df8e0e4ea0570.text: Where my brother walks, I walk.

d7ca2b1256aa5ceb3f1d2cbfe8a3c687.speaker: Dasharatha
d7ca2b1256aa5ceb3f1d2cbfe8a3c687.text: Go then, both of you. And come back to me.

39ed86fff7c1b75209b5d73a629e800d.speaker: Vishvamitra
39ed86fff7c1b75209b5d73a629e800d.text: Come, princes. The Sarayu is waiting, and so is what I have to teach you.

929736149c8812a8149a83500da4a270.speaker: Narration
929736149c8812a8149a83500da4a270.text: So the two princes walked out of Ayodhya behind the sage, bows on their shoulders, toward a forest no one entered.

c7475caa263c4fb930f7b001e5274e79.speaker: Lakshmana
c7475caa263c4fb930f7b001e5274e79.text: Brother... look. The forest is breathing again.

abc00805449c6cb4811171b8ca98fade.speaker: Vishvamitra
abc00805449c6cb4811171b8ca98fade.text: The curse is lifted from this land. You did not strike in anger, Rama. That is why you may now receive what I carry.

fbe7d63594619b820ce697e377135d5b.speaker: Rama
fbe7d63594619b820ce697e377135d5b.text: It does not feel like a victory, Guru-dev.

0e029bebda38e97b4d691527b2984f93.speaker: Vishvamitra
0e029bebda38e97b4d691527b2984f93.text: That weight is why the astras will obey you. They are never given to those who feel nothing.

ae28355b138a837c021194caf16a869b.speaker: The Astras
ae28355b138a837c021194caf16a869b.text: Command us, and we will come.

9446a678af0438d9014f8570e14ce3bf.speaker: Vishvamitra
9446a678af0438d9014f8570e14ce3bf.text: Agneyastra, the fire that burns only what must burn. Varunastra, the water that cleanses. Vayavyastra, the wind that clears the field.

b81b93f0e7cf3d5f5b3f94ed9cdbd4ee.speaker: Rama
b81b93f0e7cf3d5f5b3f94ed9cdbd4ee.text: I will call on them only for dharma, Guru-dev.

96f2bed07a1120da3d59b1e0bf9c5b76.speaker: Narration
96f2bed07a1120da3d59b1e0bf9c5b76.text: And so the princes walked on toward Siddhashrama, where six nights of fire awaited them...

cb163cf284997ff035a3f840313996a0.speaker: Tataka
cb163cf284997ff035a3f840313996a0.text: Princes of men, in my forest? I will grind your bones to dust as I did the others.

fb0d0b2ca9de0607387c64c135993d22.speaker: Rama
fb0d0b2ca9de0607387c64c135993d22.text: Guru-dev, she is a woman. Is there no other way?

674a0cb46a1912d0f09a625cdc40056a.speaker: Vishvamitra
674a0cb46a1912d0f09a625cdc40056a.text: Ask instead: how many have no other way while she lives? A protector's duty does not look away.

092e616539c92d3a53c1799e09b1a0c5.speaker: Vishvamitra
092e616539c92d3a53c1799e09b1a0c5.text: Kings before you have stopped those who destroy the innocent, whoever they were. That is not cruelty, Rama. It is care for the many.

364c4d3de314570121cee028d708169a.speaker: Rama
364c4d3de314570121cee028d708169a.text: Then I will try to turn her back first. If she will not turn, I will not look away.

8226ba0f22df0503d8dae10afafa0986.speaker: Rama
8226ba0f22df0503d8dae10afafa0986.text: It burned without touching me, Guru-dev. Is that what power is?

62edc5d65d9db342d806d903264bbf55.speaker: Vasishtha
62edc5d65d9db342d806d903264bbf55.text: That is what restraint is. Remember the feeling.

ffdafa1436857fa49698557280e0d216.speaker: Vasishtha
ffdafa1436857fa49698557280e0d216.text: Another teacher will place that fire in your hands. When he does, it will weigh more than it did today.

5e5fe17d54c19dd7b48621e7f47dcffd.speaker: Herald
5e5fe17d54c19dd7b48621e7f47dcffd.text: My princes! A sage stands at the palace gate: Vishvamitra of Kaushika's line.

8bf23ef9355cd0c01f1f34c5826694d4.speaker: Lakshmana
8bf23ef9355cd0c01f1f34c5826694d4.text: Vishvamitra? The king who became a sage?

e9e45e94eab187dcd115ebab944e71b8.speaker: Vasishtha
e9e45e94eab187dcd115ebab944e71b8.text: Go to your father. Whatever the sage asks, remember that a promise made in Ayodhya is kept.

d3413235fef8502f45e70bc8dc95c4f1.speaker: Lakshmana
d3413235fef8502f45e70bc8dc95c4f1.text: I'm hit... give me a moment, brother.

497022546e12b890a9985b237928bd91.speaker: Lakshmana
497022546e12b890a9985b237928bd91.text: A sage waits at the gate, brother. But the palace is full of people who could use our help.

6a919fd5c01757c6e699643d7364c3a9.speaker: Rama
6a919fd5c01757c6e699643d7364c3a9.text: Then let us walk through it first. We will go to the gate when it is time.

ba589013664e481853272e38551536a3.speaker: Scribe
ba589013664e481853272e38551536a3.text: Every leaf back in its bundle. The old tales are safe, Prince Rama.

d093ffc16840ee6707f960b3a65f6045.speaker: Scribe
d093ffc16840ee6707f960b3a65f6045.text: Still a few leaves out there, my prince. Look where the wind would carry them.

673833d55499a9fae2e61f8195b35437.speaker: Scribe
673833d55499a9fae2e61f8195b35437.text: Prince Rama! A wind off the Sarayu tore my bundle open. The old tales are scattered over the courtyard.

16d1f4fcbc464066a700a3efcf9f578a.speaker: Rama
16d1f4fcbc464066a700a3efcf9f578a.text: Then we will gather them, every one.

d31371b87062182020b4a75051566cdb.speaker: Sumantra
d31371b87062182020b4a75051566cdb.text: Six targets before the sand ran out. I will tell the king myself.

ab68fc3f4b87fab7a7003f44b29bb0b7.speaker: Sumantra
ab68fc3f4b87fab7a7003f44b29bb0b7.text: A wager, young prince: six targets on the range, before this sand runs out.

ddbbe4e82afebb3cdf7ff217d858595f.speaker: Lakshmana
ddbbe4e82afebb3cdf7ff217d858595f.text: He accepts. I would bet on him against the whole army.

291de8c2721ceb38be9b7ee30fa6407b.speaker: Sumantra
291de8c2721ceb38be9b7ee30fa6407b.text: Again? Good. The sand is turned.

51fb7ea070670829084d32cae40126ce.speaker: Grandfather
51fb7ea070670829084d32cae40126ce.text: May you always find what others have lost, Prince Rama.

bb62a6a1d880950725714ae8efe11379.speaker: Grandfather
bb62a6a1d880950725714ae8efe11379.text: Chandu loves to hide. He thinks he is a tiger.

069af94a1ecc85570067c213c46acf91.speaker: Grandfather
069af94a1ecc85570067c213c46acf91.text: Forgive me, my prince. My grandson Chandu ran off in the crowd, and my eyes are not what they were.

249d8ae6144eda8243418fa84a847840.speaker: Rama
249d8ae6144eda8243418fa84a847840.text: Rest here, grandfather. We will find him.

1ebae09f4f575267c9028987a3ba35bf.speaker: Chandu
1ebae09f4f575267c9028987a3ba35bf.text: Shh! I am a tiger, hunting in the garden!

312077d256c1b3c69f31c9df120affa1.speaker: Rama
312077d256c1b3c69f31c9df120affa1.text: A brave tiger. But your grandfather is looking for you. Will you walk with me?

ab4ec87b0ee21ba9512905195299fa4c.speaker: Grandfather
ab4ec87b0ee21ba9512905195299fa4c.text: Chandu! Thank you, Prince Rama. A kind heart is the first strength of a king.

96a90af087a86d2837f877c705bfb9dd.speaker: Gardener
96a90af087a86d2837f877c705bfb9dd.text: The guru smiled, they tell me. Thank you, my prince.

58631064e07fa112a4544fcda9be7e6f.speaker: Gardener
58631064e07fa112a4544fcda9be7e6f.text: The lotuses float by the steps of the kalyani. Take them to Guru Vasishtha.

e2ccc258f3cace5b0f2d1c383d41ba4d.speaker: Gardener
e2ccc258f3cace5b0f2d1c383d41ba4d.text: The guru's worship needs lotuses, but my old knees cannot manage the kalyani steps any more.

6030e4db1a2cc2567f330ad55de18ea6.speaker: Vasishtha
6030e4db1a2cc2567f330ad55de18ea6.text: Lotuses from the gardener, carried by a prince. Service is the root of every strength, Rama.

515b5a11b93f72dfc73ebd00cc3749a6.speaker: Vasishtha
515b5a11b93f72dfc73ebd00cc3749a6.text: A sage waits at the gate, Rama. Go when your heart is ready.

337b20531b48753c2d83578a5f89c2ce.speaker: Lakshmana
337b20531b48753c2d83578a5f89c2ce.text: The sage is waiting, brother. Let us go.

138bd9dac9563c0c056c1f180c20f816.speaker: Sumantra
138bd9dac9563c0c056c1f180c20f816.text: Six! The sand still running! I have lost my wager gladly.

520967ff6f93f2a97b50e4424f5e8ac8.speaker: Lakshmana
520967ff6f93f2a97b50e4424f5e8ac8.text: The forest grows quiet again. Too quiet.

a09bc6d221e2ea9736bb30fd9e042bd9.speaker: Lakshmana
a09bc6d221e2ea9736bb30fd9e042bd9.text: Rakshasas, brother! Real ones, this time.

93b3af9b48ebb5c24870cb9d65f84085.speaker: Lakshmana
93b3af9b48ebb5c24870cb9d65f84085.text: He had already turned to flee...

09a2fac3279e80452e362e32dde2dee7.speaker: Vishvamitra
09a2fac3279e80452e362e32dde2dee7.text: His maya shields him! Only Agni's fire can end Subahu!

58bb94793326bc1812ec0108c083a687.speaker: Vishvamitra
58bb94793326bc1812ec0108c083a687.text: Maricha falters. The Manavastra carries without killing, Rama.

1145ed2f861544a2156e2de51894e6b9.speaker: Lakshmana
1145ed2f861544a2156e2de51894e6b9.text: Too many! Let Vayu sweep them back!

074baf9efdd29c5130b30f90401c2656.speaker: Lakshmana
074baf9efdd29c5130b30f90401c2656.text: The huts are burning! Varuna's waters, brother!

5684ebb2cd1dc6a6023b84432c694011.speaker: Rama
5684ebb2cd1dc6a6023b84432c694011.text: This one I will not kill. Let the sea teach him what mercy is.

b86953111f253e488e99dd4df5f702bb.speaker: Rama
b86953111f253e488e99dd4df5f702bb.text: Then let him remember that he was spared.
